{"description":"BUILT 2026-08-20 as tools/wall_check.py against req:modularity-computed. GENERALISED 2026-08-21 (PROPOSAL 3, Anthony's word) from a reflow2-only script into something that works on whatever project a design describes.

⭐ IT NEEDS NO CONFIGURATION, AND THAT IS THE DESIGN. The design already says where its code lives: every Artifact carries a `location`, and REALIZES says which Component that file is part of. So the file set, the component mapping and the project layout all come from the graph. Nothing to point at a repo, no language to declare, no paths to keep in step. A reflow2 user gets this the moment they have registered artifacts, which link-artifacts already asks them to do.

WHAT IT REPLACED, and the measurement that justified it: the first version GUESSED. It walked `crates/*/src` — hardcoded — and matched a Rust module to a Component BY NAME. Held against the declared mapping on reflow2's own graph the two disagreed IN BOTH DIRECTIONS: name-matching reached 48 components, the graph 45, with 4 only in the graph and 7 only in the name match. A tool answering 'is your decomposition sound' cannot be guessing which file belongs to which part of it. The guess is also structurally blind to every non-Rust file, while a location is just a path — the declared mapping reaches .py, .yaml and .md.

WHAT IT REPORTS: cycles at EVERY declared level, not only subsystems; coupling lifted through containment; and a comparison of what the DESIGN says against what the SOURCE does, in both directions.

⭐ IT NEVER QUIETLY GUESSES, which is the property the tests pin hardest. Files in a language it has no reader for, files the design names and disk lacks, components pointing at no file, and imports resolving to no registered file are each COUNTED AND NAMED. A file the tool cannot parse is not a file with no dependencies, and reporting it as clean would be the vacuous zero this whole increment exists to end.

⚠️ AND IT DOES NOT CALL A DIFFERENCE A DEFECT. A pair the design declares and the source lacks is reported as exactly that, with the reason stated: a contract can be real without an import — a process boundary, a file format, a human step — and this reads imports only.

PROVEN ON ITS FIRST REAL RUN: it found `cmp:compare -> cmp:report`, declared a `function_call` with `weight_basis: evidence`, made FALSE eight hours earlier by PR #265 when `is_design_type` moved to `nodes`. Nobody had updated the design. Snapshotted and removed under epoch:wall-check-works-on-any-project.

STATED LIMIT, unchanged and load-bearing: an import graph is COUPLING, NOT A CONTRACT. These numbers answer 'does the wall I declared hold' and must never be written back as CONSUMES — see fact:adopt-ran-on-reflow2-and-the-mechanical-contract-recovery-collapsed, where a mechanical scan proposed 91 against a real 17.

IT REMAINS AN INSTRUMENT, NOT A GATE, and exits 0 always. Whether a subsystem cycle should stop the build is a governance question with an owner. Its own test suite IS a gate (tools/test_wall_check.py, wired into ci.yml and the AGENTS.md gate block).","name":"A declared wall is checked against the coupling it contains — on any project, with no configuration","provenance":"authored","status":"realized"}
